verdict.rationale: Docs describe a review queue (transaction-reviews) that lets analysts examine flagged payments without reviewing every payment individually, with Risk Insights showing risk factors and a network view of related payments (same customer ID, IP, or card) that provides customer-history and similar-case context, plus API endpoints to approve/reject reviews. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that the queue UI actually surfaces this context well in practice, and no explicit 'similar cases' clustering feature beyond the related-payments network.
